preferences.intro: Choose what you receive and how. Your notifications are in the
preferences.receiveHelp: Receive: turn a category off to stop receiving it at all. Categories marked with a lock are safety-related and always delivered.
preferences.digestHelp: Instant: shown and sent as soon as it happens. Daily digest: kept in the inbox, then one summary of each day's unread notifications the next day (up to the last 7 days, shown as a toast and emailed like the "Daily digest" category). In-app only: kept in the inbox, no toast, email or summary. Days follow this computer's time zone. Silence until: no toast or email for the category until then.

ptw_expired.title: Work permit {{code}} expired but still open

di_returned.title: Request {{code}} returned for clarification
di_returned.body: {{title}}: details are needed from the requester

di_approved.title: Request {{code}} approved
di_approved.body: {{title}}: it can be converted to a work order

pm_follow_up_created.title: Follow-up raised from PM — {{code}}
pm_follow_up_created.body: {{title}}: a finding created a request or work order

site_rule_received_on.title: Four-eyes lifted at {{site}} on another PC
site_rule_received_on.body: {{changed_by}} allowed self-approval of reliability decisions and work permits at {{site}} on {{changed_at}} — reason: {{reason}}. Check that this change was intended (Settings › Rules per site).

site_rule_received_off.title: Four-eyes restored at {{site}} on another PC

three_person_received_on.title: Three-person lock removal turned on for {{permit_type}} on another PC
three_person_received_on.body: {{changed_by}} required a third person to confirm lock removal for {{permit_type}} on {{changed_at}} — reason: {{reason}}.

three_person_received_off.title: Three-person lock removal turned off for {{permit_type}} on another PC
three_person_received_off.body: {{changed_by}} removed the third-person check of lock removal for {{permit_type}} on {{changed_at}} — reason: {{reason}}. Check that this change was intended (permit types).

loto_forced_removal.title: Forced lock removal: {{point}} (permit {{permit}})
loto_forced_removal.body: {{authorised_by}} authorised {{removed_by}} to take off the lock of {{worker}}, who was absent, on {{removed_at}} — reason: {{reason}}. The worker must be told (Work permits › forced removals to follow up).

insp_anomaly_origin_cancelled.title: Originating anomaly cancelled: {{code}}
insp_anomaly_origin_cancelled.body: The inspection anomaly {{code}} was raised from was cancelled: its condition is no longer detected ({{anomaly}}). {{code}} is not changed: check whether it is still needed. A required permit review stays in place.

rel_decision_refused_wo_kept.title: Reliability decision refused: {{code}} kept
rel_decision_refused_wo_kept.body: The decision “{{decision}}” was refused at synchronisation (its approval is not valid on a PC). Work order {{code}} created from it is kept: check whether it is still needed.

rel_decision_refused_pm_kept.title: Reliability decision refused: plan {{plan}} v{{version}} published, to review
rel_decision_refused_pm_kept.body: The decision “{{decision}}” was refused at synchronisation (its approval is not valid on a PC). Version {{version}} of plan {{plan}}, published from it, stays in force: review it and publish another version if it does not fit.

wo_permit_rule_type_changed.title: Work order {{code}}: required permit changed from {{previous_permit_type}} to {{permit_type}}
wo_permit_rule_type_changed.body: The plant's permit rules applied here give work order {{code}} rule {{rule}} ({{permit_type}} permit) instead of {{previous_rule}} ({{previous_permit_type}} permit). Check the permit planned for this work.

wo_permit_rule_other_on_arrival.title: Work order {{code}} received started with rule {{received_rule}} ({{received_permit_type}} permit) instead of {{rule}} ({{permit_type}} permit)
wo_permit_rule_other_on_arrival.body: Work order {{code}} was received started with rule {{received_rule}} ({{received_permit_type}} permit), while the plant applies rule {{rule}} ({{permit_type}} permit) here for its equipment and work. Check how this work was protected.

wo_permit_rule_missing_on_arrival.title: Work order {{code}} received started without permit rule {{rule}}
wo_permit_rule_missing_on_arrival.body: Work order {{code}} was received started without plant rule {{rule}} that applies here: a {{permit_type}} permit for its equipment and work. Check how this work was protected.

pm_concurrent_versions.title: Two concurrent versions of plan {{plan}} — check the version in force
pm_concurrent_versions.body: {{title}}: v{{version}} ({{version_status}}, created {{version_created_at}}) and v{{other_version}} ({{other_status}}, created {{other_created_at}}) were created on two PCs before they synchronised, both numbered {{stored_number}}. Every PC shows them as v{{version}} and v{{other_version}}; the version in force is the published one (PM › plan).

permit_suspended_work_held.title: Work order {{work_order}} on hold: permit {{permit}} suspended
permit_suspended_work_held.body: Permit {{permit}} was suspended (reason: {{reason}}). Work on {{work_order}} is stopped: it can resume only once the permit is reinstated.

permit_ended_before_start.title: Work started under an ended permit: {{permit}} (work order {{work_order}})
permit_ended_before_start.body: Received by sync: permit {{permit}} was closed, cancelled or suspended on another PC on {{end_at}}, before work on {{work_order}} started here on {{start_at}}. Stop the work and review the sync conflict.

permit_ended_during_work.title: Permit ended during the work: {{permit}} (work order {{work_order}})
permit_ended_during_work.body: Received by sync: permit {{permit}} was closed, cancelled or suspended on another PC (on {{end_at}}) while work on {{work_order}} runs here since {{start_at}}. Stop the work and review the sync conflict.

permit_ended_before_start_untimed.title: Permit ended on another PC, work started here: {{permit}} (work order {{work_order}})
permit_ended_before_start_untimed.body: Received by sync: permit {{permit}} was cancelled on another PC, at a time sync does not give; work on {{work_order}} started here on {{start_at}}. The order cannot be established: make sure the work is stopped and review the sync conflict.

permit_ended_during_work_untimed.title: Permit ended during the work: {{permit}} (work order {{work_order}})
permit_ended_during_work_untimed.body: Received by sync: permit {{permit}} was cancelled on another PC (time not known) while work on {{work_order}} runs here since {{start_at}}. Stop the work and review the sync conflict.

permit_suspended_during_work.title: Work running while permit {{permit}} was suspended (work order {{work_order}})
permit_suspended_during_work.body: Received by sync: permit {{permit}} was suspended on another PC from {{end_at}} to {{reinstated_at}}, while work on {{work_order}} was running here (since {{start_at}}). The permit is in force again: review the sync conflict.

permit_suspended_around_start.title: Work started while permit {{permit}} was suspended (work order {{work_order}})
permit_suspended_around_start.body: Received by sync: permit {{permit}} was suspended on another PC from {{end_at}} to {{reinstated_at}}, and work on {{work_order}} started here on {{start_at}}, during that suspension. The permit is in force again: review the sync conflict.

pm_duplicate_occurrence.title: Two concurrent versions of plan {{plan}} — due date planned twice
pm_duplicate_occurrence.body: {{title}}: versions v{{version}} and v{{other_version}} each have an occurrence due {{due_at}} ({{due_basis}}), work orders {{work_order}} and {{other_work_order}}. Nothing was cancelled: keep one and cancel the other yourself.

stock_negative.title: {{code}} below zero at {{location}}
stock_negative.body: {{title}}: {{on_hand}} on hand, below zero since {{opened_at}}. Record a count to reconcile it.

stock_double_count.title: {{code}} counted twice at {{location}}
stock_double_count.body: {{title}}: {{count}} counts recorded on different PCs. Check the stock and record a new count.

stock_count_recount.title: Count {{code}} at {{location}} again
stock_count_recount.body: {{title}}: the approval of your count {{session}} was refused, the stock moved since (from {{system_qty}} to {{on_hand}}). Count the location again from the stock to reconcile.

stock_count_second_approval.title: Count {{session}} held here — {{code}} at {{location}}
stock_count_second_approval.body: {{title}}: counted and approved by {{counter}} above the four-eyes tolerance, it is held here (the stock does not move). To settle on the PC where it is applied: a second approval by another person, or the count's cancellation.

stock_count_recount_reversed.title: Count {{code}} at {{location}} again
stock_count_recount_reversed.body: {{title}}: your count {{session}} was cancelled for want of a second approval. Count the location again from the stock to reconcile.

admin_grants_to_review.title: Administration rights removed: grants to review
admin_grants_to_review.body: {{people}} no longer holds {{rights}} (removed on {{since}}). {{count}} grant(s) made by this person since then are present on this PC: {{grants}}. Nothing was withdrawn automatically; please check them.

password_change_refused.title: Password change received without the right: not applied
password_change_refused.body: {{account}}: password changed on {{changed_at}} by {{author}}, who did not (or no longer) hold user management here. This PC kept the current password (an account that arrived this way has no password on this PC). If the change was intended, an administrator makes it again; that also corrects the other PCs.

password_change_from_older_version.title: Password change received from an older version: not applied
password_change_from_older_version.body: {{account}}: password change sent by a PC with an older Maintafox version (it does not say who made it): not applied. Update that PC, then change the password again.

account_reenable_refused.title: Account re-enable received without the right: not applied
account_reenable_refused.body: {{account}}: account re-enabled on {{changed_at}} by {{author}}, who did not (or no longer) hold user management here. The account stays disabled on this PC. If it was intended, an administrator enables it again; that also corrects the other PCs.

grants_from_former_authors.title: Rights received from someone who no longer holds the right
grants_from_former_authors.body: {{count}} grant(s) received from another PC were applied, but their author no longer has the right to grant them and this PC does not know since when: {{grants}}. Please check them.

rules.title: Notifications — recipients and escalation
rules.companyHint: The categories are fixed by Maintafox; who receives them, the acknowledgement and the escalation are your plant's.
rules.hint: Each category is raised by Maintafox when its condition occurs (work order overdue, request to review, PM missed…). Choose who receives it. People only see the notifications of modules they are allowed to view.
rules.readOnly: Read only: changing these settings needs the permission ref.manage.
rules.loadError: The notification settings could not be loaded
rules.escalationNeedsAck: Escalation only applies to categories that must be acknowledged.

fixedRouting.budget_control_alert: Recipient chosen in the budget alert settings.
fixedRouting.daily_digest: Sent to each person who chose the daily digest.
fixedRouting.loto_forced_removal: Always the people holding the permit close right at the permit's site.
fixedRouting.pm_concurrent_versions: Always the people holding the PM planning right (pm.edit) plant-wide, and those holding it at the site of the plan's equipment.
fixedRouting.permit_suspended_work_held: Always the responsible of the permit’s work order; when it has none, the people holding the permit close right at the permit’s site.
fixedRouting.permit_ended_under_work: Always the responsible of the permit’s work order and the people holding the permit close right at the permit’s site.
fixedRouting.wo_permit_rule_missing: Always the people holding the permit issue right at the work order’s site (and plant-wide); when nobody holds it, the settings administrators.
fixedRouting.insp_anomaly_origin_cancelled: Always the responsible of the work order raised from the anomaly (or from its request); when there is none, the work order’s planner and the request’s reviewer (else the responsibles of its node).
fixedRouting.rel_decision_refused_wo_kept: Always the planner of the work order created from the decision (else its responsible), or the holders of the PM planning right (pm.edit) for a published plan version, and the person who proposed the decision; when nobody is active here, the holders of the right to approve reliability decisions (ram.manage).

rules.escalationHint: While nobody acknowledged a notification and its condition still holds, each level notifies its target the given number of minutes after the alert. Delays increase from one level to the next.
rules.retentionHint: Notifications older than this expire (from {{min}} to {{max}} days; shipped value {{default}} days).
rules.locked: Locked: a safety notice, always sent and never synchronised.
